memory_update.text: STRA should remain a priority underfollowed candidate for employer-funded workforce education because Workforce Edge, Sophia Learning, and employer-affiliated enrollment map directly to the node.
ATGE is a healthcare-specific workforce-training beneficiary where the chokepoint may be clinical/talent pipeline formation rather than generic online course delivery.
UDMY belongs in the discovery lane because enterprise ARR and HR-system integrations create a cleaner employer-funded learning exposure than the consumer marketplace narrative suggests.

Need a later-layer verification pass on market capitalization, analyst coverage, customer concentration, employer-funded revenue mix, and whether disclosed partnerships convert into measurable revenue.

node: Employer-funded workforce training and short-cycle certificates
summary: Expanded the universe around employer-funded workforce training with emphasis on second-order and underfollowed public-market mappings. The most relevant lane is not generic online course volume, but companies with enterprise partnerships, employer-affiliated enrollment, workforce-benefit platforms, healthcare talent-pipeline relationships, or enterprise learning systems tied to measurable skill gaps.
